task_name: Check completeness, gaps, risks and review readiness
output_text: {"gaps":[{"gap_id":"GAP_001","missing_information":"A glossary or legend for acronyms and codes such as MPA, MPC, MPA-SIP, HPSRS, REC, ROI, POI, OP-OV, and OP-MB is not provided in the source.","why_it_matters":"Without code meanings, downstream model elements may be named or grouped incorrectly, especially for logical/physical architecture and traceability references.","suggested_human_action":"Provide or confirm the project glossary before deriving architecture-level model elements."},{"gap_id":"GAP_002","missing_information":"Explicit interface descriptions, data flows, and control relationships between the named components are absent; the matrix mostly provides traceability links only.","why_it_matters":"Interface and interaction models cannot be derived reliably from traceability alone.","suggested_human_action":"Review whether separate interface documentation exists and link it to the corresponding components."},{"gap_id":"GAP_003","missing_information":"Validation criteria, pass/fail thresholds, and test procedures for the listed test IDs are not included.","why_it_matters":"Verification models can reference tests, but cannot define measurable acceptance behavior without criteria.","suggested_human_action":"Obtain the test specifications or acceptance criteria for the referenced test IDs."},{"gap_id":"GAP_004","missing_information":"Several rows are fragmented, wrapped, or blank, and some identifiers repeat across multiple sections without explicit explanation.","why_it_matters":"This can cause incorrect row parsing, duplicated associations, or missed traceability links.","suggested_human_action":"Validate the original CSV in a spreadsheet or parser and normalize duplicated or wrapped rows before modeling."},{"gap_id":"GAP_005","missing_information":"The full system boundary and relationship between the various subsystems/components is not explicitly stated.","why_it_matters":"Architecture derivation may over-assume whether entries are subsystems, hardware parts, software features, or labels.","suggested_human_action":"Confirm the intended system boundary and classification of component labels."},{"gap_id":"GAP_006","missing_information":"Operational workflow sequences and function decomposition are not explicit, even though many user-facing behaviors are stated.","why_it_matters":"A functional model can only be preliminary without sequence and decomposition detail.","suggested_human_action":"If a functional breakdown is needed, provide source material that describes workflows or feature grouping."}],"ambiguities_and_risks":[{"risk_id":"RISK_001","topic":"Row parsing integrity","description":"Line wrapping and delimiter-only rows may distort the mapping between requirements, specifications, tests, and verification references.","potential_impact":"Traceability may be misassigned or lost during import.","suggested_review_action":"Manually spot-check the original CSV structure against a rendered spreadsheet view."},{"risk_id":"RISK_002","topic":"Repeated identifiers","description":"Some SSRS and other identifiers recur across multiple UR rows; it is unclear whether this reflects shared reuse, copied links, or duplication artifacts.","potential_impact":"Model deduplication could collapse distinct relations or incorrectly multiply them.","suggested_review_action":"Confirm whether repeated identifiers are intentional shared trace links."},{"risk_id":"RISK_003","topic":"Undefined abbreviations","description":"Terms like ROI, POI, MPA, MPC, and REC are used but not defined in the provided artifact.","potential_impact":"Semantic interpretation of requirements and components remains provisional.","suggested_review_action":"Request a glossary or authoritative reference for the abbreviations."},{"risk_id":"RISK_004","topic":"Traceability vs interface semantics","description":"The source provides association-style traceability, but not explicit operational interfaces or connectivity.","potential_impact":"Deriving interface behavior from these links would be unsupported.","suggested_review_action":"Limit interface modeling until explicit interaction descriptions are available."},{"risk_id":"RISK_005","topic":"Validation ambiguity","description":"Test IDs and verification references are present, but success criteria are missing.","potential_impact":"Verification models would be incomplete and potentially misleading.","suggested_review_action":"Collect test case definitions before building verification logic."},{"risk_id":"RISK_006","topic":"Architecture classification ambiguity","description":"Named entries such as MPA, MPC, TRAY-012, XY-FW, and Z-FW may represent different abstraction levels, but the artifact does not distinguish them.","potential_impact":"Physical and logical model structure may be inferred too aggressively.","suggested_review_action":"Confirm whether each named item is a subsystem, component, feature label, or implementation artifact."}],"review_questions":[{"question_id":"RQ_001","question":"What do the abbreviations and codes MPA, MPC, MPA-SIP, HPSRS, REC, ROI, POI, OP-OV, and OP-MB mean in this project?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"CSV header and component/specification rows","reason":"Needed to interpret component names and traceability references correctly."},{"question_id":"RQ_002","question":"Are repeated identifiers such as SSRS-MPA-058, SSRS-MPA-059, SSRS-MPA-145, SSRS-MPA-148, and SSRS-MPA-149 intentional shared references or duplicated rows?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"Repeated UR sections and SSRS entries","reason":"Affects normalization and trace-link correctness."},{"question_id":"RQ_003","question":"Which rows or documents define the actual interfaces, communication paths, or control flows between the named components?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"Component and traceability columns","reason":"Required before any interface model can be considered complete."},{"question_id":"RQ_004","question":"What are the pass/fail criteria and measurable acceptance conditions for the referenced test IDs and REC-linked verification items?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"Test ID, REC-Nr. Specification, and verification columns","reason":"Needed for verification modeling and review readiness."},{"question_id":"RQ_005","question":"Should MPA, MPC, MPA-SIP, TRAY-012, XY-FW, and Z-FW be treated as logical subsystems, physical components, or naming labels only?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"Component column and related specification rows","reason":"Determines whether architecture derivation is valid or only preliminary."},{"question_id":"RQ_006","question":"Is there a separate source that defines the system boundary and the intended function grouping for the requirements listed here?","related_artifact_or_candidate":"Overall CSV artifact","reason":"Needed to avoid over-interpreting the traceability matrix as a complete functional specification."}],"recommended_review_decision":"incomplete_but_reviewable"}
